context: Evaluates correct usage of the three navigation state hooks (useWormholeState, useWormholeActions, useWormholeMeta) to consume wormhole context. Tests that state slices are accessed from the correct hook, that rendered values accurately reflect context state, and that error handling for missing provider is correct.

checklist.name: useWormholeState Usage
checklist.description: useWormholeState() is used (not useWormhole().state directly) to access reactive state fields: velocity, warpPhase, cameraMode, isWarping, warpIntensity

checklist.name: Correct State Fields
checklist.description: The component accesses the correct fields from WormholeState: progress, velocity, targetVelocity, cameraMode, isWarping, warpProgress, warpPhase, warpIntensity

checklist.name: useWormholeActions Usage
checklist.description: useWormholeActions() is used to obtain action callbacks when interaction is needed, keeping action references stable

checklist.name: useWormholeMeta Usage
checklist.description: useWormholeMeta() is used to access non-reactive meta values (infiniteCurve, getSpeed, getProgress, geometryVersion) when needed

checklist.name: Provider Error Guard
checklist.description: The hooks throw an error (or the component propagates it) when used outside a WormholeProvider, with a meaningful error message
